name: S5

styles.$comment: Theme stylesheet(s) that define the CLOSED class vocabulary the Authoring Contract validator enforces (Build Order Step 4). The class vocabulary is the union of class selectors parsed from these files — there is no hardcoded class list. Paths are relative to the repo root. Add component/utility stylesheets here as the design system grows (Authoring Contract Part A: tokens/scales/generated/utilities/components).
styles.$tokensComment: Design-token stylesheets (Authoring Contract Part A2/A3): custom properties ONLY, no class selectors, so they add nothing to the class vocabulary. The editor Style tab (Build Order Step 12) parses these live to render the palette / type ramp / spacing / radius, so the tab can never drift from the real tokens.

assets.$comment: Local asset directory the media resolver (Build Order Step 6) resolves canonical relative media references against. Canonical HTML references images by portable relative path (e.g. src="assets/hero.png", srcset="assets/hero-wide.avif") — NEVER attachment IDs, upload URLs, or srcset. On compile each relative / ref is sideloaded into the environment's media library (matched by content hash so re-imports dedupe) and the DERIVED render gets that environment's attachment URL + srcset + dimensions. 'dir' is relative to the repo root; the 'assets/' prefix in a reference maps to this dir.

site.$comment: Authoritative site identity for the S5-owned schema graph (Build Order Step 9, PRD §13.2). WebSite + Organization JSON-LD are compiled from THESE values plus each page's own head (title/description/canonical), so structured data cannot silently drift from visible content. Placeholder-tier for the test corpus; replace with real values before launch.
